explanation:
[EFFECT] The hour of day has a strongly non-monotonic effect: overnight hours (blue, low values) push predicted demand very far down, while certain daytime hours (red/orange, higher values) raise it above the baseline — the widest swing of any feature. The exact peak hour cannot be pinpointed from this plot alone, but the positive contributions clearly come from the higher-value hours.
[IMPORTANCE] This is by far the most important feature, with a spread from roughly −3 to +1.3 in log space — larger than all other features combined.
[RECOMMENDATION] Focus operational planning — bike availability and staffing — primarily on the hour of day and temperature, as these two features drive the vast majority of demand variation; ensure full availability during warm-weather daytime hours and scale back overnight and in cold conditions.
